description: A Perl script named check-non-portable-shell.pl that analyzes shell script files to identify non-portable commands and options. It checks for various patterns indicating portability issues such as usage of 'cp -a', 'sed' options, 'echo' options, arrays declaration, and certain commands like 'which', 'test', 'wc', 'head', 'seq', 'grep', and environment variable exports.

methods.name: err
methods.description: Logs an error message for a detected non-portable command/function and sets the exit code to 1.
